name: ntfy Notifier

author: MailFlow community
readme:
## ntfy Notifier

Pushes mail alerts to [ntfy](https://ntfy.sh) topics — works with the public ntfy.sh service or any self-hosted ntfy server, so alerts land on your phone via the ntfy app.

### Features

- Optional auth token for private topics (`Authorization: Bearer`)
- Urgency mapped to ntfy priorities (ad=min, info=default, important=high, urgent=urgent)
- Standard library only (urllib)

### Usage

```toml
[[notifiers]]
notifier_id = "ntfy"
provider = "ntfy"
enabled = true
minimum_urgency = "important"
[notifiers.options]
base_url = "https://ntfy.sh"      # or your self-hosted server
# token = "${NTFY_TOKEN}"         # optional, for private topics
```

### License

MIT — contributions welcome.

## mailflow-notify-ntfy

把邮件提醒推送到 [ntfy](https://ntfy.sh) 主题——支持公共 ntfy.sh 或任何自建 ntfy 服务器，配合手机 ntfy 应用即收即达。

### 特性

- 可选鉴权令牌，支持私有主题（`Authorization: Bearer`）
- 紧急度映射为 ntfy 优先级（ad=min、info=default、important=high、urgent=urgent）
- 仅用标准库（urllib）

### 配置

```toml
[[notifiers]]
notifier_id = "ntfy"
provider = "ntfy"
enabled = true
minimum_urgency = "important"
[notifiers.options]
base_url = "https://ntfy.sh"
# token = "${NTFY_TOKEN}"
```

MIT — 欢迎贡献。
